stages.title: 第一節 · 機制與病理生理（免費試學）

steps.title: 機制與病理生理
steps.objective: 掌握老化十二大標誌的背景與基本機制。
steps.objectiveEn: Grasp the background and basic mechanism of The twelve hallmarks of ageing.
steps.instruction: 閱讀並整理：基因體不穩定、端粒磨損、表觀改變、蛋白穩態喪失、營養感測失調、粒線體功能障礙、細胞衰老、幹細胞耗竭、細胞間溝通改變、巨自噬失能、慢性發炎、菌相失衡。
steps.instructionEn: Read and organise: Genomic instability, telomere attrition, epigenetic alterations, loss of proteostasis, disabled macroautophagy, deregulated nutrient sensing, mitochondrial dysfunction, senescence, stem-cell exhaustion, altered communication, chronic inflammation and dysbiosis.
steps.observationEn: Draw the causal chain as a flow diagram.
steps.failure: 把相關性誤認為因果是最常見的推理錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking correlation for causation is the most common reasoning error.
steps.check: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
steps.checkEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.

knowledge.title: 核心摘要
knowledge.text: 基因體不穩定、端粒磨損、表觀改變、蛋白穩態喪失、營養感測失調、粒線體功能障礙、細胞衰老、幹細胞耗竭、細胞間溝通改變、巨自噬失能、慢性發炎、菌相失衡。
knowledge.textEn: Genomic instability, telomere attrition, epigenetic alterations, loss of proteostasis, disabled macroautophagy, deregulated nutrient sensing, mitochondrial dysfunction, senescence, stem-cell exhaustion, altered communication, chronic inflammation and dysbiosis.

knowledge.title: 術語
knowledge.text: 先定義名詞，再討論機制。
knowledge.textEn: Define terms before discussing mechanisms.

quiz.question: 「機制與病理生理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Mechanism and pathophysiology'?
options: 已正確完成「蛋白穩態喪失」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
病例推理完整。
已正確完成「基因體不穩定」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: 'loss of proteostasis' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
Case reasoning complete.
'Genomic instability' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 原理與設計（免費試學）

steps.title: 原理與設計
steps.objective: 說明部分重編程與表觀年齡逆轉的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where Partial reprogramming and epigenetic age reversal applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：OSK 因子、小鼠視神經再生與安全。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: OSK factors, optic-nerve regeneration in mice and safety.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: OSK 因子、小鼠視神經再生與安全。
knowledge.textEn: OSK factors, optic-nerve regeneration in mice and safety.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。

steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。

steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

optionsEn: The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
